news.title: Man gets 135 years for shooting at GSP troopers, wounding K9
news.summary: A Conyers man who fired at multiple Georgia State Patrol troopers and shot a patrol K9 during a high-speed chase on Interstate 85 has been sentenced to years behind bars.

news.title: Wanted suspect found hiding in southeast Atlanta basement, police say
news.summary: A wanted suspect facing dozens of previous charges across metro Atlanta was arrested after officers found him hiding inside the basement of a southeast Atlanta home, police announced.

news.title: Mother seeks justice after son fatally injured coming out of moving truck; says driver never stopped, witness called 911
news.summary: Nathaniel Morgan, 18, died Sept. 10 after reportedly coming out of a moving truck in Bartow County. The sheriff's office is investigating.

news.title: Cobb officials to address Six Flags tragedy ahead of park reopening
news.summary: Cobb County leaders and police officials will hold a press conference Friday afternoon to address community concerns surrounding the recent tragedy at Six Flags Over Georgia, county officials announce

news.title: Driver hospitalized after crash on I-85 N in Gwinnett County, police say
news.summary: A driver was hospitalized Friday morning following a two-vehicle crash on I-85 N near Jimmy Carter Boulevard, according to the Gwinnett County Police Department.

news.title: Fake cash, stolen bike: Tennessee man claims he was scammed in DeKalb County
news.summary: He said he was conned out of $12,000 while trying to sell his Suzuki GSX-R600 motorcycle on Facebook Marketplace.

news.title: Third suspect in shooting of Norfolk Southern contractor near railway property arrested out of state
news.summary: Cobb County Police said the Escambia County Sheriff's Office in Florida arrested 27-year-old Ty Anthony Thompson on Thursday.

news.title: 2 students arrested for bringing weapon to DeKalb County high school, principal says
news.summary: According to the school's principal, police arrested the two students, who will face both legal and disciplinary consequences.
